start.title: Home AI Assistant
start.ai_text_message: - Send a regular text message (not a command) to get an assistant reply.
start.ai_clear_available: - Command /clear clears the current dialog context.
start.command.start: Show this message with available capabilities.
start.command.id: Show your Telegram ID; in reply mode shows sender/source info.
start.command.ask: Explicitly send a request to the AI assistant.
start.command.clear: Clear AI dialog context for the current user.
start.command.settings: Open settings UI with sections and action buttons.
start.command.settings_raw: Show all saved settings in raw format.
start.command.terminal: Enable terminal mode for shell commands.
start.command.cancel: Cancel pending input (for example, text setting input).
start.command.player: Open inline controls for system media playback.
start.command.pc_link: Link a client PC using one-time code.
start.command.pc_run: Run a remote skill command on a client PC.
start.command.pc_share: Grant another user access to a client PC.
start.command.pc_unshare: Revoke user access to a client PC.
start.command.pc_unlink: Unlink a client PC from the server.
start.command.grant: Grant a permission to user or role.
start.command.revoke: Revoke a permission from user or role.
start.command.role_assign: Assign a role to a user.
start.command.user_roles: Show roles of the selected user.
start.command.user_permissions: Show full permission report for the selected user.
